name: Roblox
description: Blocky figures in bright code-built places: a cast of drawn-faced characters, eight locations, hard cuts and a camera that pushes, pulls, orbits or cranes. Every shot has a gesture and a caption band drawn from the voice's own word times.

cautions: The pack builds its own pixels: it asks the studio for no pictures. Studio's planner may still plan stills until the asset model grows a "none" value; the render ignores them.
Not affiliated with Roblox Corporation. The figures are the kit's own blocky characters and its own drawn faces; no Roblox asset, avatar, logo or game is used.
The cast is a small fixed set of presets, so a script longer than eight shots reuses faces. Keep films to a handful of characters.
Captions are drawn by the kit from the voice's word times, inside the lower band. Do not also burn captions on the worker or they will double.

provenance.ref: the Roblox Claude kit (/opt/data/robloxkit): engine/, web/engine/{core,chars,props,acting,sets,studio}.js, characters/hero.json, assets/faces
provenance.licence: owner — the kit is this studio's own work (package.json private: true); the art is drawn by its code
provenance.notes: Vendored into render/assets/engine and its faces inlined as data URLs. One edit to studio.load(): the choreography comes from a hook instead of /video/shots.js. The sets, characters, camera language and caption drawing are the kit's, unchanged.

provenance.ref: three.js 0.170.0 (three.module.min.js) and its examples/jsm/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js, from the kit's node_modules
provenance.notes: Vendored rather than fetched: the capture sandbox has no network. The kit's own import of 'three' is rewritten to the vendored file.

provenance.ref: venturazz/venstudio-styles docs/style-naming.md: one look, one style — three Roblox kits (threejs, remotion, hybrid) are this one style
provenance.notes: The name was reserved before the pack existed. The engine choice is an implementation detail: html-capture, because the kit already renders one frame per request.
